title: John Handy and Shelly at the Vida
summary: After Handy was fired Robinson was put in the band, getting Paul Brown and Kid Howard; the trumpeter Shelly is discussed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: John Handy? Oh yeah, I worked with him too.
Let's see, we talked about recording too. That's another thing. Oh, oh Handy, we never did finish Handy. We better finish with it.

Where did you work with Handy? I worked with Handy. I worked with Handy at the Vida before I took the band in charge. I worked with Handy at the Vida. And after fired Handy, well they put me into the band, you see. They put me into the band, that's where I got Paul Bones and I got Kid Howard. Well they had, Shelly was playing trumpet then too. Shelly? Shelly, well they fired, the old man fired both of them fellas and he got handy in uh, in Kid Howard, old man's bikes.
Is that the Shelly that used to be with Paul Bones' Big Bam and in the, around Lake Charles, you know?
I think he did. I think Shelly was up there playing that band. I think he was.
Is he alive Shelly? What do you mean? Is he, is he alive now Shelly?
Oh yes, since he died late, I don't know. Last time I seen him he's living. Yeah. He lived downtown somewhere around the, down the 9th Ward somewhere around the 7th Ward, you know?
